verses.18:35: وَدَخَلَ جَنَّتَهُۥ وَهُوَ ظَالِمࣱ لِّنَفۡسِهِۦ قَالَ مَآ أَظُنُّ أَن تَبِيدَ هَٰذِهِۦٓ أَبَدࣰ ا

meaning: بَيْدَ (bayda) is a particle meaning "except that" or "but," often used to introduce a contrasting idea. It can also mean "because of" or "on account of".
